security_audit.summary: Most Markdown backtick findings are false positives for tool names or examples. The real risks are the unpinned external clone, npm install and build commands, and local services that receive a workspace path. No prompt injection text was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the agentMemory repository to a reviewed commit or release and publish checksums or review notes before installation.

remediation.issue: Workspace path is passed to local services
remediation.suggestion: Document the exact filesystem scope used by the MCP server and dashboard, and recommend a minimal project directory.

remediation.issue: Local dashboard exposure is not explained
remediation.suggestion: Document the dashboard bind address, authentication model, and safe shutdown steps for the localhost service.

content.value_statement: AI agents lose project context across sessions, which slows repeated work. This skill adds searchable memory for decisions, patterns, and architecture notes.
actual_capabilities: Provides setup instructions for an MCP server backed by a persistent memory bank.
Supports memory search by query, memory type, and tags.
Records decisions, architecture notes, and patterns with keys and optional tags.
Retrieves saved memory entries by key for later project sessions.
Shows memory statistics and offers a local dashboard for usage review.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 and a separate repository clone before use.
The setup runs npm commands from external community code.
Memory quality depends on what users save and maintain.
Workspace path access should be reviewed before starting the server.

use_cases.title: Preserve Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Save important design choices so future sessions can recover context quickly.

use_cases.title: Reuse Project Patterns
use_cases.description: Search for established implementation patterns before changing related code.

use_cases.title: Track Memory Health
use_cases.description: Review memory usage and coverage through statistics and a local dashboard.

prompt_templates.title: Find Related Memory
prompt_templates.prompt: Search project memory for prior decisions about authentication. Return the matching keys and short summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Save A Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Save this architecture decision with a clear key, decision type, concise content, and relevant tags.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Against Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Search memory for patterns related to background jobs. Compare them with the current task and recommend the closest match.

prompt_templates.title: Maintain Release Memory
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced memory hygiene after major changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review recent project changes and update memory with new decisions, retired patterns, and missing context for future agents.

output_examples.output: Found two related entries: the main authentication design and a token refresh pattern. Both include security review notes.

output_examples.input: Save the new cache invalidation decision.
output_examples.output: Saved a decision entry with a clear key, cache-related tags, and a short explanation for future sessions.

output_examples.input: Show memory statistics for this project.
output_examples.output: Returned counts by memory type, recent activity, and areas with limited saved context.

best_practices: Use stable keys that include the feature name and decision topic.
Add tags for domain, component, and lifecycle stage.
Review saved memories after major architecture or workflow changes.
anti_patterns: Do not store secrets, credentials, or private customer data in memory.
Do not run setup commands before reviewing the external repository.
Do not treat stale memories as current project truth without validation.

faq.question: What does this skill store?
faq.answer: It stores searchable project knowledge such as decisions, architecture notes, patterns, and related tags.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require a server?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow starts an MCP server from a separate Node.js project.

faq.question: Can it search existing memories?
faq.answer: Yes. The memory_search tool supports query text, memory type, and tags.

faq.question: Is there a dashboard?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents a local dashboard available at a localhost address.

faq.question: What should users review before setup?
faq.answer: Users should review the external repository, npm scripts, workspace path scope, and dashboard exposure.
